title: An episode's publish queue (council/podcast/queue/<episode>.json)
description: Written by the session that prepares an episode's posts, approved by Wendell on the board (pa-approval-publishes), published by .github/workflows/publish-queue.yml. The approval covers `episode` and `posts` only; `state` and `numbers` are written by the workflow.

episode.description: Matches the file name, e.g. mtgoa-ep03.

title.description: How the board names the episode, e.g. Episode 3, with Marina.

approval_row.description: The board question whose answer approves this queue.

title.description: A few words for the board and the issue, e.g. Clip 1, how long (Tom).

at.description: When it publishes: ISO 8601 with an offset, e.g. 2026-10-19T09:00:00-07:00.

clip.description: Reels only. A GitHub release asset on this repo, or a local path (tests and container-test only).

cover.description: Reels only. Repo path of the cover JPEG (9:16, 8 MB or less). Published as its raw.githubusercontent.com URL on main.

image.description: Image posts only. Repo path of the JPEG.

collaborators.description: Instagram handles, only when Wendell names them (Diplomat, pass podcast-pipeline2).

state.description: Per post, per network: status (published, failed, missed), ids, times, error. Written by the workflow.

numbers.description: Per post, per network, per Monday: the insights read back (pa-numbers-auto). Written by the workflow.
